title: Aug. 1 to Sept. 12, by number of 100° days
subtitle: Camp Mabry is Austin's official reporting site; its records begin in 1898
alt: Bar chart of the number of days reaching 100 degrees or hotter at Camp Mabry in Austin between August 1 and September 12, for the four highest years on record: 39 days in 2026, 38 days in 2023, 38 days in 2019 and 36 days in 2011
source: KXAN First Warning Weather, from Camp Mabry records
